description: The check and each carrier's result: status waiting, complete or incomplete; the label shown and caller name; flagged true/false; a screenshot link. Set wait_seconds (up to 25) to wait for results to arrive before answering.

api_key.description: Optional API key (sia_...), if your connection has none and you got one from get_approval

token.description: The token from start_check, for a check started without a key

name: get_check
title: Get a check's results
